user_goal: Improve the trackside appearance of generated courses while playing
primary_outcome: Trackside areas have credible depth, variety and visual quality similar to native tracks

criterion_guidance.scene-depth: Roadside ground and terrain must show depth and natural transitions from the actual in-game camera
criterion_guidance.variety: Repeated segments should not look identical across multiple course views
criterion_guidance.material-coherence: Surfaces and props must match their setting without visibly conflicting with terrain
criterion_guidance.track-legibility: Road boundaries and kerbs must remain readable while driving

severity_anchors.minor: Only noticeable when inspecting side by side
severity_anchors.major: Obvious flat or repetitive roadside area during normal gameplay

priority_order: Preserve driving behavior and track legibility
